notes.title: PROZE is TIGA awards finalist!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33430879/d24d60580c842df0d8b6af8ca77a3f20578d39a4.png[/img]
🏆🏆 We're incredibly proud to announce PROZE: Enlightenment has been shortlisted for the Best Action and Adventure Game and for the Best Visual Design TIGA awards!

It is a pleasure to see among finalists our nationals Frogwares with their game The Sinking City, a few games from our favorite studio's Ninja Theory, PlayStation London Studio and other amazing games.

🎮 The 2019 TIGA Games Industry Awards will be held on Thursday 7th November at the iconic Natural History Museum, London.

✔️ The shortlist is live here: https://tiga.org/awards/2019-shortlist

✔️ Vote for PROZE for the #Gameoftheyear here: https://tiga.org/awards/game-of-the-year

Thanks to all the Judges. Have a great day!

notes.title: The fourth patch here!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33430879/464ca6b3a1984fc97ad555c25ca581ea08dbb073.jpg[/img]
Hi folks! 
We’d like to say thanks to those who continue to support PROZE: Enlightenment and give us feedback since the release.

We’ve just rolled out a new patch that includes some new features and bug fixes. 
Please find the full changelog below.

[h1]Features [/h1]
-[b]3D Rudder locomotion support [/b]
Winner of 4 CES “Innovation Awards” foot controller
Move through PROZE: Enlightenment with your feet.
Check out the info on the controller here: 
https://www.3drudder.com/

-[b]Depth of field[/b]
When you put an object in front of your face, the background becomes cinematically blurry.
Now you can turn on/off this feature in the menu.


 [h1]Improovements [/h1]
- Reactor level: coolant puzzle improvements
- Reactor level: energy enemies gameplay improvements
- Darkness level: gameplay improvements
- Eased reaching cables in the snowy bunker
- General game puzzles improvements
- Reactor level lights improvements
- start button localization
- textures improvements
- 3D models optimization

[h1]Bug fixes [/h1]
No bugs detected since the last patch, enjoy and stay tuned for the upcoming announcements. 

Let us know what you think!

Best regards! SignSine team.

notes.title: Patch Three is live!
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

We’re dedicated to polish everything in PROZE: Enlightenment. This week’s update comes with a lot of improvements in almost every part of the game. Hope you’ll enjoy it and don’t forget to share your thoughts!

Here’s what’s new:

- Narrator voiceover - now performed by Stephane Cornicard.
- Improved Dmitry voiceover
- Minor audio enhancements
- Fixed inventory items bugs
- Fixed item highlights
- Fixed objects sticking to hands
- Added more hints
- Lightning improvements
- Performance optimization
- Fixed multiple colliders
- Lowered difficulty level in the last puzzle
- New menu option 'Show game tips’
- Improved shadows in the Cave
- Fixed multiple gameplay issues
- Items now become invisible while in the menu
- Improved 3D models
- Improved NPC animation
- Save progress icon

Hope you’ll enjoy it and don’t forget to share your thoughts!

notes.title: PROZE: Episode I release date
notes.content:
Hi everyone,
First of all, a huge thanks to everyone who played and continues to play PROZE: Prologue!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/912560/PROZE_Prologue/
Your comments and reviews have helped to make it a much better experience.

Also, the original release date for the first full episode of PROZE was set for November. However, we’ve considered our work on the Prologue chapter and decided that we want to bring you a truly immersive VR experience – adding more detailed visuals and animations, new gameplay mechanics, additional localizations, and an expanded narrative with an epic ending. So we need a little more time for that.

PROZE Episode I: Enlightenment now releases in February 2019.

Stay tuned!

notes.title: What is PROZE: Prologue?
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33430879/9368f94b4bc291cdb392bfa71e7e46ba16fa095e.jpg[/img]
We want everyone interested to experience PROZE, and made the game’s opening chapter a completely free standalone product – so you could feel PROZE’s rich story and atmosphere just by clicking a download button. 


https://store.steampowered.com/app/912560/PROZE_Prologue/

The Prologue is set in 1976 and is a prequel to the main story. You’ll play as Soviet engineer Anatoly, who works on a secret research project called DUGA. You’ll explore Cold-War era facility, start the PR-03e experiment and find out the origins of the conspiracy that will take you to the events of the main game.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33430879/689c58311bbdbb36b27f626ffce03418b3667bc9.jpg[/img]
PROZE: Prologue sets the gameplay basics of the main game. You’ll have to investigate both the interior and exterior of the base, interact with the environment and solve puzzles. It’ll take around 30 minutes to complete this chapter.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33430879/c9d65588219777c358a22bc32dbff132030d6436.gif[/img]

[b]The Prologue will be available in a week, on August 30.[/b]
